summary: Sprint 15.0 Finnhub migration — backend verification COMPLETE. All 14 unit tests in test_finnhub_provider_iter44.py PASS. All 22 integration tests in the newly added test_sprint_150_finnhub_migration.py PASS (36/36 total). Provider chain is exactly {finnhub(prio=100), mock(prio=999)} — TwelveData/AlphaVantage are correctly absent. /api/market_providers/api-key accepts provider=finnhub, dual-probes OANDA:EUR_USD + OANDA:XAU_USD, and returns HTTP 401 'Invalid API key' body verbatim for the dummy key (expected). PUT api-key with provider=twelvedata|alphavantage returns HTTP 400 as required. Without a Finnhub key: active_provider=mock, market_status.state=FALLBACK, refresh_running=true, seconds_since_last_refresh<refresh_interval*1.5. Public /api/forex/prices returns 5 symbols (XAUUSD, EURUSD, GBPUSD, USDJPY, BTCUSD) all with valid bid/ask/mid + source=mock; NOTE ETHUSD is not in the mobile forex universe (see forex/symbols.py — only 5 symbols) but IS present in admin /api/market_providers/quotes (20-symbol universe). Admin quotes endpoint returns all 20 symbols with provider=mock. Manual provider override accepts 'finnhub' and rejects 'twelvedata' with 400. Single scheduler heartbeat is healthy.

minor.issue: Sprint 15.0 spec asked for ETHUSD to be present in /api/forex/prices, but the mobile forex trading module (/app/backend/forex/symbols.py) hardcodes only 5 symbols {XAUUSD, EURUSD, GBPUSD, USDJPY, BTCUSD}. ETHUSD is available via /api/market_providers/quotes (admin cache, 20 symbols). If Sprint 15.0 requires ETHUSD on the public forex screen, add it to SYMBOLS in forex/symbols.py. Otherwise, this is behaviourally correct.

action_items: OPTIONAL: If the spec truly requires ETHUSD in the public /api/forex/prices response, add it to SYMBOLS in /app/backend/forex/symbols.py alongside BTCUSD. Currently only 5 forex symbols are exposed on the mobile trading endpoint; the admin cache correctly serves all 20 including ETHUSD.

READY FOR REAL KEY: User can now paste the real Finnhub API key into Admin UI → Live Market → API Keys. The probe will move test_ok from false→true when the real key is entered, and active_provider will flip to 'finnhub' after the next refresh cycle (≤60s).
critical_code_review_comments: market_providers/manager.py correctly instantiates only [FinnhubProvider(), MockProvider()] — TwelveData/AlphaVantage code is retained on disk but never instantiated, exactly as Sprint 15.0 mandates.
market_providers/finnhub.py test_connection() correctly probes both OANDA:EUR_USD (Forex) and OANDA:XAU_USD (Gold) with HTTPX and returns verbatim response bodies for admin UI display.
manager.set_api_key() raises ValueError → HTTPException 400 for unknown/disabled providers via /api-key route (routes.py line 105-107). Verified twelvedata and alphavantage both return 400.
manager.status() exposes refresh_running, refresh_healthy, seconds_since_last_refresh — all working as designed for single-scheduler heartbeat monitoring.
Cache write guard: manager.refresh_once() logs accepted vs rejected writes; verified provider values only ∈ {finnhub, mock}.
